_comment: Registry of workflows the Supervisor can run. Add a new entry here to supervise another integration later — no other file needs to change.

selftest.name: Supervisor Self-Test
selftest.what_it_does: A dummy workflow that validates the supervisor pipeline end-to-end (run -> detect success -> Slack). Touches nothing real.

selftest_fail.name: Supervisor Self-Test (Failure)
selftest_fail.what_it_does: Dummy failing workflow to validate the supervisor FAILED Slack report (no auto-fix).

selftest_login.name: Supervisor Self-Test (Login)
login_required_markers: Not logged in to TikTok Seller Center
selftest_login.login_help: This is only a self-test of the login alert. (Real one tells you to run the workflow once in visible mode to log in.)
selftest_login.what_it_does: Dummy to validate the login-required Slack alert preempts auto-fix.

tiktok_toship.name: TikTok To-Ship Tracking Sync
login_required_markers: Not logged in to TikTok Seller Center
tiktok_toship.login_help: TikTok Seller Center session has expired. On the server, run it ONCE in visible mode to log in: `venv\Scripts\python.exe tiktok_toship_export_raw.py` — a Chrome window opens, log into TikTok, and the saved session will work for scheduled runs again.
tiktok_toship.what_it_does: Exports TikTok 'awaiting shipment' orders, matches them to Shopify, looks up shipped tracking in my-fulfilment.com (Nic. Oud), and uploads tracking back to TikTok.
known_issues: The final upload step sometimes logs 'UPLOAD RESULT: no confirmation detected after final submit' EVEN WHEN THE UPLOAD SUCCEEDED. TikTok's real success screen reads 'Added tracking info for N parcels' and is saved to a screenshot logs/tiktok_upload_result_*.png. If the log shows 'Workflow completed successfully', treat the run as SUCCESS regardless of that warning.
my-fulfilment.com sometimes returns HTTP 500 and/or its session expires; the script already auto-retries and re-logs-in. A few 500 warnings in the log are NORMAL, not a failure.

If Chrome fails with 'session not created: Chrome instance exited', it is usually a ChromeDriver-vs-Chrome version mismatch or a stale chrome_profile lock. Fix: kill leftover chrome/chromedriver processes, then re-run (webdriver_manager auto-updates the driver).
